name: 3DO Interactive Multiplayer
significance: Pioneered a consumer-electronics open licensing model (avoiding console royalties), but suffered commercial failure due to its prohibitive $700 price point.

editorialContent.overview: Trip Hawkins' ambitious hardware licensing model seeking to create a standardized consumer multimedia audio-visual platform.
